title: In-product contextual help: compact doc-link cards & side-panel tooltips
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and asset handoff for an in-product inline help system: compact doc-link cards that appear inline (tooltip hover / keyboard focus) and an optional right-side contextual panel for deeper how-tos. The goal is to reduce first-time user friction during quickstart flows and release notes onboarding by surfacing short, actionable docs and screenshots without leaving the console.
acceptance_criteria: Compact doc-link card component in Figma with copy variants (short, medium) and recommended CTA: 'Open docs', 'See example', 'Start quickstart'
Tooltip states designed for hover, focus, keyboard, and mobile tap — meets WCAG 2.1 contrast and focus order requirements
Right-side contextual panel template with header, short steps, 2–3 annotated screenshots, and 'Run sample' code snippet area
Handoff-ready export: image slices (PNG @2x), SVG icons, copy tokens, and CSS spacing tokens included
Design critique notes addressed and UX research feedback integrated (3 changes called out in review_history)
engineering_notes: Recommended implementation: single tooltip component with config for 'card' vs 'panel' modes to reuse runtime logic
Avoid heavy images in tooltip; lazy-load annotated screenshots when panel is opened
Accessibility: use aria-describedby to link trigger to panel, ensure escape key closes panel, trap focus when panel open
Performance constraint: keep tooltip payload < 6KB for initial hover; panel assets load asynchronously with skeleton placeholder
Suggested CSS tokens: spacing-xs (4px), spacing-sm (8px), spacing-md (16px) for vertical rhythm
review_history: 2026-03-07 - Design critique with PM/EM: removed bulk 'Getting started' modal in favor of contextual cards (action: use inline cards + panel)
2026-03-09 - Accessibility review (Lina Gomez): bumped color contrast on CTA from 3.8:1 to 4.5:1 and added focus ring spec
2026-03-11 - Eng sync (Marco Chen): requested smaller initial payload and lazy-load pattern; design updated to defer screenshots
QA_checks: Keyboard navigation: tab to tooltip trigger, Enter/Space opens card, Right Arrow opens panel, Esc closes panel
Screen reader: tooltip content announced on focus; panel announces 'Contextual help panel' with role=dialog
Localization-ready: designs show expanded layout for DE/FR copy (120% width) — verify truncation rules
Visual regression: compare snapshots for light/dark themes and high-contrast mode
decisions: Prefer inline cards over persistent inline banners to reduce UI noise on high-density dashboards
Card copy limited to 1 sentence + one micro-CTA to keep cognitive load low
Panel includes up to 3 annotated screenshots and a small runnable example rather than full docs to encourage progression to docs page when needed
